steps.en: Install the package; a prebuilt native libcurl comes inside the wheel
steps.zh: 安装这个包，预编译的原生 libcurl 随 wheel 一起装上

steps.en: Make an ordinary request, naming the browser to look like
steps.zh: 像平常一样发请求，只多指定要模仿哪个浏览器

steps.en: Replays that browser's recorded TLS/JA3 and HTTP/2 handshake
steps.zh: 复现该浏览器录好的 TLS／JA3 与 HTTP/2 握手

steps.en: Returns a requests-style response for you to read
steps.zh: 返回 requests 风格的响应供你读取

value.en: You stop hand-tuning headers or launching a headless browser just to get past fingerprint-based blocking
value.zh: 你不必再手动调 header，也不必为了绕过指纹封锁而拉起无头浏览器

sources: https://github.com/lexiforest/curl_cffi README (pip install curl_cffi; curl_cffi.get(..., impersonate="chrome"); 'Pre-compiled, so you don't have to compile on your machine'; requests-like API; Session/Response)
